conditions.server_timezone: logical-server operating-system local timezone for authoritative world time

change.summary: Restore the complete Halloween GUI, make seasonal music yield to audible record players and keep skylit worlds at midnight only during the annual Halloween window

modifiers.before: The locally rewritten ZIP had corrupt local headers after its first GUI entries, so enabled textures resolved to missing-resource checkerboards
modifiers.after: The official CurseForge file 9143523 is intact and retains every GUI texture, with only its opaque panorama overlay removed so the approved FancyMenu background remains visible

modifiers.before: The JEM-owned AudioYT background track continued at full gain while a vanilla record or positional AudioYT jukebox was audible
modifiers.after: The owned seasonal track is muted without stopping while an audible record source is in range and its configured MUSIC gain resumes outside that range

modifiers.before: World day time followed the existing daylight rule throughout the Halloween window
modifiers.after: Every skylit dimension without fixed time is held at Minecraft midnight while the logical server calendar is October 30 through November 2, then JEM stops writing time on November 3

modifiers.before: AudioYT 1.0.1 was present only on the client even though upstream declares side BOTH and requires protocol audioyt_1_20_1:main
modifiers.after: The exact same AudioYT 1.0.1 JAR is installed on the dedicated server and clients so native jukebox packets and Forge channel negotiation have one owner

cause.owner: JEM Holidays and upstream AudioYT integration

rationale.purpose: Keep the Halloween presentation complete, avoid simultaneous music and apply the requested annual night without permanent world or gamerule changes
rationale.decision_source: The user reported the checkerboard GUI, overlapping record-player and background music, the AudioYT channel rejection and requested permanent night during the Halloween dates. The implementation uses upstream AudioYT positional payloads and logical-server time authority as the smallest native seams

introduced.summary: Repair seasonal GUI/audio/server admission and add bounded Halloween midnight

history.summary: Replace the corrupt GUI archive from its official source, yield seasonal playback to audible record sources, install the required upstream AudioYT server channel and hold world time at midnight only inside the Halloween calendar window

relations: Season calendar -> client resource stack and AudioYT playlist
Record-player audibility -> owned seasonal AudioYT gain only
Server calendar -> skylit world day time
AudioYT both-side metadata -> matching Forge channel presence
notes: Unrelated sound categories, record playback, resource-pack ordering, gamerules, biome data and world data formats remain unchanged
Stable JEM and MineRENT remain outside this sandbox delivery
unresolved: Player acceptance of GUI rendering, radius transitions and the visible midnight state remains unrun
